name: T02

theorem T02 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2

author: private-a0
name: T04
source:
theorem T04 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  have e := T02 m N M
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hs
  have hS : 0 ≤ -m.S := by omega
  have hNM : 0 ≤ N * M := Int.mul_nonneg h5 (Int.le_of_lt h4)
  have h7 : 0 ≤ (-m.S) * (N * M) := Int.mul_nonneg hS hNM
  have hM2 : 0 < M ^ 2 := by
    have h := Int.mul_pos h4 h4
    have e2 : M ^ 2 = M * M := by grind
    rw [e2]
    exact h
  have h8 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (Int.le_of_lt h2) (Int.le_of_lt h3)) (Int.sq_nonneg N)
  have h9 : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos h1 hM2
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S

name: H01

theorem H01 : ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.hamGain r₁ B C ≤ Scope.hamGain r₂ B C := by
  intro r₁ r₂ B C h1 h2
  unfold Scope.hamGain
  have := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 h2
  omega
statement: ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.hamGain r₁ B C ≤ Scope.hamGain r₂ B C

author: private-a0
name: H03
source:
theorem H03 : ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.Favoured r₁ B C → Scope.Favoured r₂ B C := by
  intro r₁ r₂ B C h1 hB hF
  have h := H01 r₁ r₂ B C h1 hB
  unfold Scope.Favoured at *
  omega
statement: ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.Favoured r₁ B C → Scope.Favoured r₂ B C

name: T09
source:
theorem T09 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M hdet hDu hDv hM hN hlt
  have hS := T04 m N M hdet hDu hDv hM hN hlt
  refine ⟨hS, ?_⟩
  have h1 := T02 m N M
  have hD : 0 < m.Du * m.Dv := Int.mul_pos hDu hDv
  have hP0 : 0 ≤ N * M := Int.mul_nonneg hN (Int.le_of_lt hM)
  have hN2 : 0 ≤ N ^ 2 := Int.sq_nonneg N
  have hM2 : 0 < M ^ 2 := by
    have := Int.mul_pos hM hM
    grind
  have hA1 : 0 ≤ (m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg (Int.le_of_lt hD) hN2
  have hA2 : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos hdet hM2
  have hq : (m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 + m.detJ * M ^ 2 < m.S * (N * M) := by
    grind
  have hP : 0 < N * M := by
    apply Classical.byContradiction
    intro h
    have h0 : N * M = 0 := by omega
    rw [h0] at hq
    simp at hq
    omega
  have hA : 0 ≤ (m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 + m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by omega
  have hsq : ((m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 + m.detJ * M ^ 2) * ((m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 + m.detJ * M ^ 2) < (m.S * (N * M)) * (m.S * (N * M)) := by
    have hpos : 0 < (m.S * (N * M) - ((m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 + m.detJ * M ^ 2)) * (m.S * (N * M) + ((m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 + m.detJ * M ^ 2)) := by
      apply Int.mul_pos
      · omega
      · omega
    grind
  have hd := Int.sq_nonneg ((m.Du * m.Dv) * N ^ 2 - m.detJ * M ^ 2)
  have hPP : 0 < (N * M) * (N * M) := Int.mul_pos hP hP
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hc
  have hle : m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ := by omega
  have := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hle (Int.le_of_lt hPP)
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2
